mission_10: Neuro-Symbolic NLP combines neural text representations (word embeddings, sentence encoders) with symbolic linguistic knowledge (synonyms, hypernyms, antonyms) to improve natural language understanding. The neural component learns distributed representations from data, capturing statistical patterns in word co-occurrence. The symbolic component provides explicit linguistic relationships that may be rare or absent in training data. Combined similarity blends neural cosine similarity with symbolic knowledge-based similarity, improving robustness for out-of-vocabulary words and rare semantic relationships. In this mission, you implement word embeddings with sentence encoding via averaging and projection, a symbolic knowledge base for word relationships, symbolic similarity computation, knowledge-augmented similarity that combines neural and symbolic signals, and embedding training using contrastive learning with similar and dissimilar sentence pairs.
